Bacillary angiomatosis is caused by *Bartonella* species, most commonly *B. henselae* or *B. quintana*. HHV-8/KSHV is associated with Kaposi sarcoma, which can resemble bacillary angiomatosis clinically or histologically, but that does not establish an HHV-8 association with bacillary angiomatosis.
